native_commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "command -v zsh && python - <<'PY'
from click.shell_completion import ZshComplete
from click import Command
print(ZshComplete(Command('tuple-param'), {}, 'tuple-param', '_TUPLE_PARAM_COMPLETE').source())
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY' >/tmp/click-zsh-source
from click.shell_completion import ZshComplete
from click import Command
print(ZshComplete(Command('tuple-param'), {}, 'tuple-param', '_TUPLE_PARAM_COMPLETE').source())
PY
zsh -n /tmp/click-zsh-source; printf 'status=%s\\n' "'$?'

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY' >/tmp/click-zsh-source
